modern: The safety of life is this: to examine everything all through, what it is in itself, what is its material, what its formal part; with all your soul to do justice and to speak the truth. What remains, except to enjoy life by joining one good thing to another so as not to leave even the smallest gaps between?
original: The safety of life is this, to examine everything all through, what it is itself, that is its material, what the formal part; with all thy soul to do justice and to say the truth.
